name: PhAIL
summary: Franka FR3 真机 VLA 评测数据，包含多视角视频、遥测、动作结果和安全停止回放。
summaryEn: A real-world Franka FR3 VLA evaluation dataset with multiview video, telemetry, action outcomes, and safety-stop rollouts.
scaleZh: 594 次评测运行和 352 条示范
access: Official release with videos, telemetry, and results
accessZh: 官方发布包含视频、遥测和结果
verdict: 以真机评测回放检验动作结果和安全状态预测
verdictEn: Real-robot evaluation rollouts for action-outcome and safety-state prediction
wmNote: 失败、超时和 safety-stop 事件为世界模型风险诊断提供状态标签。
wmNoteEn: Failure, timeout, and safety-stop events provide labels for world-model risk diagnosis.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2605.29710] PhAIL: A Real-Robot VLA Benchmark and Distributional Methodology
evidence.statement: The paper identifies real-robot per-rollout artifacts and time-to-success distributions with teleoperation references. Inspect artifact fields before action-conditioned use.
